description: Weak, mixed layer-0 unit. Fires most strongly right after the opponent drops a stone in column 2 early in the game (ply 4-8), with the centre column still empty and none of my stones in column 2. A second, weaker branch: the opponent just stacked column 6 high (row 4+) while columns 1-2 are not full. Many other firings (last move in columns 0/1/3/4, mid-game) follow no clear board pattern.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes move probabilities by at most about 0.04 (usually 0.00-0.02).
notes: Layer 0, behaves like an order-insensitive bag-of-moves with strong nonlinear interactions (centre-column stones lower it for nearly every last column). Best dev F1 0.312 (P 0.37, R 0.27), AUROC 0.63, simulation share 0.12. Ply-graded variant reached AUROC 0.68 but F1 0.26. An additive token model from minimal pairs failed sanity checks. Steering effect ~0. Likely a mixture or random direction.
